profile.headline: Software Quality Manger at DNA Script
profile.summary:
Strong manufacturing experience with optical systems, specifically work with contract manufacturers.  Over two years in Thailand as an expatriate and regular ongoing work in China with CMs and JDMs.  Thrives in working with complex optical system, especially those with servo systems and debugging of control loops.  Optical skills reinforced by a strong programing and automation background.

Looking to grow professionally through new experiences and challenges.

Specialties: Expatriate, CM experience, Test development, data analysis / statistics, production development, Languages; C++, C#, PHP, Python and VB.

positions.title: Software Quality Manager
positions.locationName: Daly City, California, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Sr. Software Integration Engineer
positions.locationName: South San Francisco, California, United States

positions.title: Sr. Optical and Test Automation Engineer
positions.description:
* Developing automated calibration procedures and software for holographic displays
* New product and prototype development of holographic displays and sub-components
* Optical testing on components
* Performance testing of displays and bench-marking of performance in developments

positions.title: Sr. Test Automation Engineer
positions.description: Part of small internal team dedicated to the development on innovative cost saving optical networking components by leveraging vertical integration.  Primary tasks include automation of precision optical alignment routines with a focus on yield, throughput, and ROI costs.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description: Contractor for Alcatel-Lucent working in test system development.  Interfaced with Bell Labs team for new methods on data collection to implement a new testing system, capable of great cycle time reduction.

positions.title: Test Automation Engineer
positions.description: Part of the optical test team whose typical job functions include yield improvement, FA / Debug, NPI at CM in China and on going production support.  Yield improvement actions were data driven from the production parametric database.  Also restructured the HW interface for the test stations to allow a generalization of equipment and device under test allowing one executable for all applications.

positions.title: Sr. Manufacturing Engineer
positions.description: Re hosted programs written in VB6 to C# .  Restructured company database into a more relational and index-able format and provided new database interfaces for all production used programs.  Provided a web interface to database with reporting and data summary views.  Optical test development for free space optical system.

positions.title: Optical Manufacturing Test Engineer
positions.description: Worked with NPI team to develop test processes for new products.  Developed and documented customized manufacturing equipment for production test.  Created assembly drawings for work instructions with solid works.

positions.title: Optical Manufacturing / Test Engineer
positions.description: Worked as an expatriate at contract manufacturing site in SE Asia in the telecommunication industry, focusing in optical test and manufacturing.

positions.title: Jr. Optical Engineer
positions.description: Optically charachterized IR and Far IR materials.  Temporary contract position.

positions.title: Co-op Intern
positions.description: Composite Engineering, Inc, provided a round robin of co-op intern jobs with work in material control, machine shop, finance, and prototype manufacturing.
